title: TableState v1
description: What a table controller sees, published on tables/{deviceId}/state (QoS 1, retain). The topic names the device, the message only the cups standing on each side. See protocol/README.md.

leftCups.description: Cups standing on the left half of the table

rightCups.description: Cups standing on the right half of the table

seq.description: Counts up with every message, starts again after a restart; repeats (QoS 1) are recognised by it

sensor.description: The technique behind it (rfid, vision, hall, sim), only recorded for the evaluation
